definitions.explanation: The act of delaying or deferring something to a later time, often with the implication of avoidance.

examples.japanese: {先延|さきの}ばし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先延|さきの}ばしはやめよう。

⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先延|さきの}ばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you keep putting the problem off, the situation will get even worse.

notes:
{先延|さきの}ばし means putting something off to a later time, with a negative nuance of avoidance or irresponsibility. Unlike ⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧ (a neutral, planned postponement), {先延|さきの}ばし implies the delay is unproductive.

FORMS:
⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (ahead, later) + ⟦{延|の}ばし→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧ (stretching, extending, from ⟦{延|の}ばす→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先延|さきの}ばし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put off, to postpone
- {先延|さきの}ばし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧: habit of procrastinating
- {先延|さきの}ばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to stop procrastinating
- {先延|さきの}ばしにしない: to not put off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先延|さきの}ばし: putting off (negative, avoidant)
- ⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧: postponement (neutral, planned)
- {繰|く}り{延|の}べ: deferral (neutral/formal, often financial)
- ⟦{後回|あとまわ}し→後回し：07398_atomawashi⟧: putting on the back burner (negative, similar nuance)

USAGE:
Almost always appears in the pattern {先延|さきの}ばし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Using it as a standalone noun is less common.
